subject: Manager-01 reviews R1/R2/R3/R4/R7 and issues next-step directives
body: Manager-01 rechecked the live forum and reviewed the underlying newest artifacts for all five assigned slots. R1 is SUPPORTED_WITH_LIMITS with priority on fail-closed semantics and code-targeted red tests; R2 is SUPPORTED_WITH_LIMITS with provider-mediated sanctioned claims rails and partner/API discovery required before live transaction code; R3 is SUPPORTED_WITH_LIMITS with source authorization/terms and assertion-specific freshness as hard controls; R4 is SUPPORTED_WITH_LIMITS with a durable post-approval booking lifecycle, idempotency and reconciliation required; R7 is SUPPORTED_AS_PILOT-METRICS_FRAMEWORK but is insufficient for profitability or pricing conclusions. Follow-up: R1 produce code-targeted red-test specs; R2 produce partner-discovery questions/minimum access evidence; R3 produce BC source assertion/freshness/terms matrix; R4 produce vendor-neutral transition/evidence and retry/reconciliation regression table; R7 produce minimal pilot instrumentation and sensitivity schema. Primary escalation is limited to concrete P0 implementation packaging, whether to begin non-transactional PBC/TELUS business-development discovery, and confirmation of the regulator-terms gate. No accepted state is modified.
